scenarios.name: Add a selected command using the keyboard transfer button

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
ribbon customization is open with "All Commands" selected
the Part | Tools custom target is empty
the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available commands list
the user presses Enter while the list has focus
"2D Sketches" remains selected in the available commands list
the Part | Tools target remains empty
the user presses Tab and then Space
"2D Sketches" appears in the Part | Tools target
the target is marked as changed
